correctness.rationale: Integral Pieri and weak Lefschetz derive R_n. The polynomial identity and recurrence show a regular sequence after every field change, and so a free integral CI with the known Betti ranks. The integral top cycle c^(2n-2) evaluates to 1, giving mod-p nonzero socle and unimodular duality; pairing matrices force the tautological ring map to be an isomorphism over Z. The diagnostic integer verifier returns VERIFY_OK for n=2..12; the universal theorem follows from the written proof.
